_comment: 80 Qwen-Image-2.1 EDIT with reference images - the local compositor for @PLACE + @CHARAC1
+ @CHARAC2 in one frame. Up to 16 references on TextEncodeQwenImage21's autogrow input;
the flat ids are images.image_1 ... images.image_16 (1-indexed, names style - a nested
dict is silently ignored, playbook §95.3). Refer to them in the prompt as <image1>,
<image2>... The CANVAS FOLLOWS image_1 (resized to about resolution^2 px, multiples of 32),
so put the PLATE first when the shot is a 16:9 frame. `resolution` 1024 = ~1 MP canvas.
Knobs: 21/22/23 refs (add 24.. and images.image_4.. for more), 6 prompt/negative,
10 seed, 12 prefix. 25 steps cfg 1 euler/simple; QwenImage21Cache keeps the reference

inputs.prompt: A still frame from a live-action film: the woman of <image2> and the man of <image3> stand facing each other in the place of <image1>, medium shot.
inputs.negative_prompt: lowres, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, fused fingers, doubled figure, text, watermark, logo, nsfw
